target_group: Eligible SC, ST, BC, EBC, minority and differently-abled students
known_criteria: Students in ITI, Polytechnic, Degree and above courses, in SC/ST/BC/EBC/Minority/Differently-abled categories, sanctioned in saturation mode. MTF: total family annual income Rs.2.50 lakh or less, and family land below 10 acres wet, or 25 acres dry, or 25 acres wet and dry combined.
benefit_summary: RTF: full fee reimbursement (tuition fee, special fees, other fees and exam fees) as fixed by competent authorities, defined in G.O.Ms.No.115 SW(Edn) dt 30.11.2019 and G.O.Ms.No.04 SW(Edn) dt 18.06.2024. MTF for food and hostel expenses: Rs.10,000 per year (ITI), Rs.15,000 (Polytechnic), Rs.20,000 (Degree and above). RTF payment mode (G.O.Ms.No.87 SW(Edu.I) dt 20.11.2024): for non-SC students RTF is released to college accounts; for SC students RTF continues to be released to student accounts (GoI bears 60%).
effective_from: RTF to college accounts for non-SC students from AY 2024-25, subject to FRS attendance in colleges from AY 2025-26 (G.O.Ms.No.87 dt 20.11.2024)
notes: RTF income limit and current application dates are not included because they were not confirmed on an official page.
verification_status: Verified on official government source(s) listed

known_criteria: Age 60 or above and destitute (little or no means of subsistence and no family or relative to depend upon). Common to all pensions: BPL family holding white ration card; local resident of the district; not covered under any other pension scheme.
benefit_summary: Rs.4,000 per month (raised from Rs.3,000 by G.O.Ms.No.43 PR&RD dt 13.06.2024).
effective_from: Payable from 01.04.2024; disbursed from 01.07.2024 with 3 months arrears (Rs.7,000 in July 2024); Rs.4,000 monthly thereafter
notes: The About page still shows superseded rates (Rs.2,250 / Rs.3,000); use the G.O. for amounts. Exclusions (About page): govt/PSU employees and pensioners; income tax payers; land above 2.5 acres wet or 5 acres dry (except ST in ITDA scheduled areas); outsourced and private monthly-salaried employees; car owners; freedom fighter pension holders. Sanction: MPDO (rural) or Municipal Commissioner (urban).

scheme_name: Free Power for Handloom Weaver Households
known_criteria: Permanent resident of Andhra Pradesh; individual weaver engaged in handloom weaving; loom operational and used solely for weaving; valid Weaver Certificate from the Dept of Handlooms and Textiles or Weaver Pehchan Card issued by Govt of India; no pending dues or arrears with the DISCOM at enrolment. Documents: Aadhaar, weaver certificate or Weaver Pehchan Card, latest electricity bill, bank details, self-declaration that the connection is used exclusively for weaving; tenants need an indemnity bond from the registered consumer.
benefit_summary: Free power up to 200 units per month; subsidy adjusted automatically in the monthly electricity bill; consumption above the limit is paid by the applicant.
effective_from: Orders to implement from 01.04.2026 (G.O.Ms.No.44 Industries and Commerce (Prog-II) dt 26.03.2025)
notes: Apply at the nearest Assistant Engineer office of the concerned section; officials of the Electricity Dept and District Handlooms and Textiles Office verify jointly. Subsidy stops if the household is found not engaged in weaving.
verification_status: Verified on official government source(s) listed
